_comment: Cloudflare Workers AI. The free Workers plan grants 10,000 neurons/day, reset at UTC midnight — roughly 200-400 requests/day on a small model, and far fewer on a large one, since bigger models burn more neurons per request. Exhaustion arrives as HTTP 429 with 'you have used up your daily free allocation', which UpstreamFailureClassifier maps to QuotaExhausted/Daily and stands the provider down until midnight. REQUIRES PROVIDER_CLOUDFLARE_BASE_URL: the base URL embeds your account id and has no usable default, so the provider is skipped at startup until you set it. Models ship DISABLED — verify with ./scripts/test-all-providers.ps1 first.

models._comment: Verify with ./scripts/test-all-providers.ps1, then set enabled=true. Small models stretch the daily neuron budget furthest.
